Name: Muadhnait Revived
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
[size=4]asarigolo left permissions open for  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5053?tab=description]Custom NPC - Muadhnait[/url] so I thought I'd give her a little 1.6 revival![/size]

[size=4]Muadhnait is a mysterious child who never seems to leave the beach and has an almost...otherworldly aura to her. What's going on with this strange girl?[/size]

[size=4]Gift Tastes:[/size]
[size=4]Love: topaz, starfruit, mega bomb, void mayo, iridium bar, juice, red mushroom,  Pomegranate[/size]
[size=4]Like: artifacts[/size]
[size=4]Dislike: coffee, common mushroom[/size]
[size=4]Hate: fried eel, spicy eel, beer, wine, purple mushroom[/size]

[size=4]Heart Events:[/size]
[size=4]Intro: Beach, 6 am-8 pm[/size]
[size=4]3 Hearts: Beach, 6 am-8pm[/size]
[size=4]5 hearts: Beach, 6 am-8 pm[/size]

[size=4]This mod contains crossover content with my mod The Daycare and the Abbey. Download both for the full story![/size]

[size=4]Events w/ The Daycare and the Abbey:[/size]
[size=4]2 hearts: Beach, 6 am-8pm[/size]
[size=4]5 hearts: Beach, 6 am-8 pm[/size]

[size=4]Enjoy![/size]
[size=4]
